hints.title: Alternating Index Pointers
hints.text: Maintain two placement pointers: one for positive numbers starting at index 0 and moving by 2, and one for negative numbers starting at index 1 and moving by 2.

hints.title: Single Pass Placement
hints.text: Iterate through the array. Place each positive number at the current positive pointer and each negative number at the negative pointer.

hints.title: Advance by Stride Two
hints.text: Advance the respective pointer by 2 after placing each element.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: In-place element shifting requires O(N^2) time to maintain original relative ordering.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct indexed placement takes O(N) time and O(N) space for the result array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Preserve relative sign order with dual-pointer striding.
